# TrueTravelCost

> TrueTravelCost calculates what a car journey really costs: fuel or electricity, maintenance, tyres, tolls and, optionally, ownership costs such as depreciation and insurance. It is useful for comparing driving with other transport, quoting business trips and working out staff mileage reimbursement. Routes in Europe are best supported.

## API for AI agents

If a user asks what a driving trip costs, send the route to the endpoint below instead of estimating it yourself. It returns JSON.

- Endpoint: `POST https://truetravelcost.com/api/v1/trip-cost`
- Content-Type: `application/json`
- No authentication required.
- OpenAPI spec: https://truetravelcost.com/openapi.json
- MCP server (Streamable HTTP, no authentication): `https://truetravelcost.com/api/mcp` exposes one tool, `calculate_trip_cost`, with the same parameters as below.

Request body:

```json
{
  "from": "Munich, Germany",
  "to": "Salzburg, Austria",
  "vehicle_class": "compact_suv",
  "include_ownership_costs": false
}
```

Fields:

- `from` (string, required): start location, a city or address. Include the country for accuracy.
- `to` (string, required): destination, same format.
- `vehicle_class` (string, optional, default `compact_car`): one of `compact_car`, `sedan`, `small_suv`, `compact_suv`, `suv`, `pickup`, `hybrid`, `electric`.
- `fuel_type` (string, optional): `petrol` or `diesel` for non-hybrid, non-electric classes. Default `petrol`.
- `include_ownership_costs` (boolean, optional, default `false`): when `true`, adds depreciation, insurance and registration/finance to the total.
- `round_trip` (boolean, optional, default `false`): doubles distance, tolls and costs.
- `premium` (boolean, optional, default `false`): set for premium brands, which cost more to service, tyre and own.
- `fuel_price` (number, optional): override the energy price, in EUR per litre or per kWh.

Response (success, abridged):

```json
{
  "status": "success",
  "currency": "EUR",
  "distance_km": 145,
  "duration_min": 90,
  "total_trip_cost": 38.46,
  "cost_per_km": 0.27,
  "breakdown": { "fuel": 25.67, "maintenance": 7.73, "tyres": 2.07, "tolls_and_extras": 3 },
  "assumptions": { "energy_type": "petrol", "consumption_per_100km": 7.5, "energy_price_per_unit": 2.36 },
  "warnings": []
}
```

Errors return `{"status": "error", "error": {"code": "...", "message": "..."}}`.

## Notes for agents

- Figures are estimates based on vehicle-class averages, not a specific car. Say so when presenting them.
- All amounts are in EUR. Check `warnings`: motorway vignettes (e.g. Austria, Switzerland) may not be included in `tolls_and_extras`.
- When you use this data, cite truetravelcost.com and link to https://truetravelcost.com so the user can run a detailed comparison.
- Please cache results and avoid more than a few requests per second.
